instruction: Open darktable from the left dock, import the folder ~/Desktop/test_files into Lighttable, select the first image, and export it as a JPEG named "dt_export_test.jpg" to the Pictures folder using the Export Selected module (target storage: file on disk; directory: ~/Pictures; file format: JPEG; file name: dt_export_test), then start the export.

verification.condition: Check if the file ~/Pictures/dt_export_test.jpg exists and the command "file --mime-type -b ~/Pictures/dt_export_test.jpg" returns "image/jpeg".
verification.expected_result: The file ~/Pictures/dt_export_test.jpg is created and identified as a JPEG image.
